data.text: Glad we could all meet before heading out. My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season, and our village depends on this lake. With 100 tons now, we can catch 50 tons between us and leave 50 to double back to 100. How about 10 tons each this month? That’s $10,000 apiece, and we can keep earning that monthly if we stick to the limit. Let’s review our catches together each month and adjust if the stock drops. John, what do you think?
